description: A man in a dark frock coat, seen from behind and partly in profile, stands on a wooden platform with one arm raised, addressing a crowd of men in waistcoats, suspenders, flat caps and bowler hats in a dim, rustic wooden room lit by wall lanterns. A Cuban-style flag (red triangle with white star, blue and white stripes) hangs on the wall behind him. No visible text, no frame, no blood or violence.
